notes.title: AIdventure - Update 2.1.0-Experimental.1
notes.notes:
Hello, today I’m publishing an update in the experimental branch. This update is only fixing bugs.
Changelog
Fixed being able to upload to Steam Workshop items you are subscribed too

Fixed an error in starting menu after downloading a custom AI

Fixed saving settings to all AIs not working for custom AIs

Fixed renaming a lorebook not renaming it in the list of lorebooks

Fixed edit bar disappearing during generation

Fixed cancelling previous generation undoing the previous input too

Fixed new scenarios or lorebook not appearing without a restart of the game

Fixed bug where a lorebook inside two scenarios can be the same and lead to unwanted modification on both

Added a description to Distil-Gpt2

Fixed a loop when updating/uploading content to the workshop
How to download it?
To make it quick, I changed how I work. I’m working in what we call sprints (specific amount of time) and I plan to publish a proper release after 4 sprints. But, because some people are impatient :), I make the product of each sprint available. I did 0 test (except automatic tests) so it might not work.

On itch, download the last experimental release (2.1.0.experimental.1)

On Steam, download the sprint_release beta
What next?
To finish a sprint, it will take me between 1 month to 1.25 month.

So you can expect a proper release every 4 month or 5 months.

You can find more information in the community report of September

notes.title: AIdventure - Update 2.1.0-Experimental
notes.notes:
Howdy adventurers,


Today, I’m releasing an exciting new version. It will be in open beta for now.


If you want to experiment the newest AIs and a faster generation, you should give this beta a try!


This also introduce the assisted generation, more detail about this below.

Changelog

Implemented the assisted generation
Added a wiki page about the assisted generation
Added support for Llama AIs.
Added open_llama_3b_v2, Llama-2-7b and Llama-2-7b-chat AIs to the game.

Nvidia driver update

If you didn’t update your drivers since a while, you might need to do so. The server will print an error about your nvidia card not being up-to-date.

For users on Itch

Updating the environment on Windows will download ~3GB of data, but the processing might take some minutes. Be patient.

What is assisted generation?

It is using a small AI (the assistant) to accelerate the processing of your prompt.
The assistant will process your inputs and deduce what words come next, then it will ask the big AI to confirm the result.


Here is a video (thanks to Hugging Face for their videos) explaining what happens without the assisted generation


Video


Now, let’s have a look at what happens when you use an assistant


video


For more details, you can read their article here: https://huggingface.co/blog/assisted-generation

notes.title: AIdventure - Release 2.0.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,


Today, the 2.0.5 is coming out of the beta.


This patch features bug fixes and quality of life improvements

Changelog
New content

Spanish Localization

Changes

A new dock with information about the data sent to the server.
The context used to be x characters long, even if it cuts a sentence in the mi (middle of a word like what just happened). Now it will try to not cut any sentence.
Some windows now grab focus when they appear
The story now supports BBcode. The inputs should appear in bold (Result might change depending on your font)
Added an option to choose the colour of the highlighted text
The keywords of the lorebook are now highlighted in the input bar! (It has some limitation regarding caps. Moreover, keywords with whitespace aren’t highlighted)
The AI menu and the server menu now automatically refresh the list of AIs when you delete or download one.
Added an in game wiki (There isn’t many articles for now)
Added a popup to help users having the following errors:

“Cuda out of memory”
“error loading checkpoint


Added a button to create an email with all the information needed for the helpdesk.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the menu asking you to load the generator, never selecting the default AI.
Fixed the exclusive fullscreen not working correctly (replaced it by default fullscreen mode)

Server

Added a fallback to change the value of torch_dtype to avoid the “topk_cpu” not implemented for ‘Half’ error.

Support me

If you like my work and want to help me, please, review AIdventure on Steam or rate it on Itch! It’s very important and can help me a lot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/3e27414862896f98b7ab1dd6c979610d45c330b4.gif

What is coming next ?

For now, I will keep working on small improvements and bug fixes.


See you.

notes.title: Update 2.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

I’m releasing a patch today. It’s focusing on quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

Changelog

Changes

Added the supporters to the credits! Become a supporter on https://ko-fi.com/lyaaaaagames
Added a confirmation dialog when trying to close the AI options menu without saving changes.
AI settings are now hidden until you select an AI.
Changed of logging system
All the logs (server’s and client’s) are now centralized in a single logs.txt file inside the game’s folder.
Updated the settings preset and auto preset to reduce the user’s memory input by 1Gb to limit the risk of memory overflow during generation of big stories.


Bug fixes

Fixed English being an option when selecting an AI translator (Led to crash)
Fixed the extreme and major success of rolls being ([code]x < stat/5[/code] and [code]x < stats/2[/code] where it should be [code]<=[/code] instead.)
Fixed the settings preset and auto preset not taking account of user’s inputs.
Fixed the text in the confirmation dialog when downloading a translator.



Rate the game and review it!

If you like my work and want to help me, please, review AIdventure on Steam or rate it on Itch! It’s very important and can help me a lot!

See you next time.

notes.title: Hotfix of the open beta. 2.0.0.BETA.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I’m publishing a hotfix for the 2.0.0.BETA. It fixes a few urgent problems.
Important info about AIs
The AIs are now stored in a new folder. Instead of being in the game’s folder, they will now be in the user’s data folder.

To move your AIs, open the old folder path/to/game/models and move them to this folder:

Windows: %APPDATA%\aidventure\models
Linux: ~/.local/share/aidventure\models

Don’t forget to use the new hierarchy:

models/ 
-- translators/  
-- generators/  
-- customs/

ChangelogThe text inside the input bar will now be wrapped (instead of having a horizontal scroll bar).Fixed the lorebook not being saved when editing it during a game.The text inside the notification won’t be clipped any more.Fixed the download error of AIs.Fixed the list of saves expending over its boundaries.Updated the server logs’ display to scroll down automatically as new text appears.Disabled the button “load translator” until you select a translator.Fixed duplication in the context leading to the AI repeating your inputs.Fixed the context and memory being repeated in the AI’s output when using the automatic translationWhat next?
I have more stuff to fix and the localization to update. But you can expect the stable release for the 12th.

notes.title: Release 1.5.2 - Performances and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Today I'm releasing a long awaited patch. It fixes bugs, expand the number of compatible graphical cards and greatly improve the performances.

With all these changes you will have to redownload the AIs! You can delete the old ones.


 Changelog

 Summary

Here is a little summary of the improvements

- No more memory peak when the AI is loading.
- The possibility to specify how much memory you allow (on both CPU and GPU).
- The option to use a folder to write data instead of storing it in the memory (It's called offloading).
- Many new options for those who like to experiment.
- AI split into parts of 200 MB to allow a better memory management.

Client

- Added 8 options. Here is a list of the most useful:
  - Offload model (Instead of running out of memory, the server will write on your disk)
  - limit_memory (Allows you to specify a maximum of memory for the server*)
    - gpu_max_memory (The maximum VRAM allowed)
    - cpu_max_memory (The maximum RAM allowed)
- All the files needed for a model are now saved in the same folder.
- Added `accessible_regular` font for better accessibility.
- Updated the credits.
- Fixed the server's logs never being displayed in the client.
- Fixed an error when loading scenarios from the Steam Workshop.
- Added the GPT4All-J model (Please, give me feedback about this model :))

* The limit of memory isn't perfect. It's a limit only for loading AIs. During the generation you will go above it.

 AIs

- The AIs have all been modified (cut into small parts) to optimize their performances. You can learn more about how it works in this video

[previewyoutube=MWCSGj9jEAo;full][/previewyoutube]

Server

- Updated the dependencies (It makes compatible many graphical cards).
- The server is now capable to use both the CPU and GPU at the same time. Greatly improving the performances for users owning a compatible GPU.
- Updated the config file to give more control over the server when in self-hosting mod. 

You can find a full changelog of the server on GitHub https://github.com/LyaaaaaGames/AIdventure_Server/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0

notes.title: Pre-Release 1.5.2-BETA.1
notes.notes:
Hello, today I'm releasing a big update!

It doesn't add any content but greatly improve the performances of the game.
Because it brings a lot of breaking changes, it will remain in experimental for some time.
To use this new version, enable it in the beta tab on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822818/0492674e36f797d347392f4cce5e4953ad619aa9.gif

Limitations

- The models KoboldAI/GPT-J-6B-Adventure and KoboldAI/GPT-J-6B-Skein aren't supporting the new version yet.
- You have to redownload all the models.

Client

- Made compatible the client with the new server's version.
- The AI's files are now all stored in the same folder in `models`
- Added many new options to optimize the performances.
- Added an option to allow the server to download the AI by itself (It will be useful for custom models, later).

Server

- The server can now run the AI on both the GPU and CPU at the same time.
- No more memory peak when loading the AI
- Added an option to limit the memory used (for both the GPU and CPU)
- Added an option to write data in a folder instead of using the memory
- The config file has now much more options.

Full server's changelog here
